section.title: Starting CTDI measurement
section.hierarchy_path: /System operation/Function tests/Using the Customer CTDI service function/Starting CTDI measurement

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Starting CTDI measurement
You do not need a personal account and password for the Customer CTDI service function.
The special scan protocols have been defined according to your requirements.
The scan protocols are saved in the special folder with the required file names and file types.
The current patient study is closed.
1 Call up Options > Service > Local Service, delete the password entries, and click OK .
The Home Menu dialog window is displayed.
2 Click on the Quality Assurance button to display the Quality window.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
4 System operation
3 Select Quality > Customer CTDI in the Quality window.

4 The software is displaying a list of the scan protocols in the Special folder. Select the desired scan protocol from the list, and a sequence scan is generated and parameters are displayed on the screen.
The protocol is loaded.
If no protocol could be loaded, check the following steps:
◆ Remove non-used ranges and recon jobs. ( Page 176 Deleting all non-used ranges and recon jobs)
◆ Deactivate CARE Dose4D on the Scan parameter card. ( Page 176 Adapting the scan protocol parameters)
◆ Save the scan protocol as CTDI_* in the Special folder. ( Page 177 Saving the defined scan protocol)
5 If the protocol has been loaded successfully, you are prompted to insert the required CTDI phantom and prepare the dosimeter.
Click Go when you have completed your preparations.
Follow the instructions on the screen to perform the CTDI measurement.
7 Press the Start key on the control box.
The system starts the CTDI measurement.
8 When the scan is successfully completed, an image is automatically saved to the Service Patient in the Customer CTDI study.
The image is assigned with a series for each scan protocol type used. Each series also carries the same name as the protocol type associated with it.
9 Click Repeat to repeat the measurement.
New CTDI measurements generate another image in the image series.
The images are overwritten when starting a new CTDI measurement with the same scan mode. To archive the data of the CTDI measurement, use another storage or storage media.
– or –
Click Done to finish the CTDI measurement.
The Customer CTDI service function is completed and the database is automatically cleaned up.

section.title: Importing user scan protocols
section.hierarchy_path: /Examination/Configuration of examination settings/Scan Protocol Assistant/Importing user scan protocols

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Importing user scan protocols
You can import scan protocols from a CD-R/DVD-R or a USB device.
The scan protocols that are displayed depend on your system licenses.
You can only import scan protocols that have been exported from an equivalent CT system having the same or an older software version.
1 Insert the medium on which the scan protocols are stored.
2 Copy the scan protocols data to the H:\SiteData\ImportScanProtocols folder via the File Browser .
3 Click the Import user scan protocols option on the step 1 page of the Scan Protocol Assistant .
4 Click the step 2 button.
The list of scan protocols to be imported is displayed.
5 Select the protocols you want to import.
6 Click the Import button to import the selected scan protocols.
The selected scan protocols are copied to the system and placed on the corresponding body region in the Scan Protocol Assistant .
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 254
6 Examination
7 Click the step 3 button.
The step 3 Confirmation page is displayed.
8 Click the Yes button to make further changes.
– or –
Click the End button to finish the import.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 6 Examination
5 Press and hold the Move key until the patient table has reached the saved position at the RT Laser.
The marks on the patient are lined up with the external RT Laser again.

If you configured the Automatic table zeroing and manually set the table position to zero in the tools area after automated zeroing has been performed, the manual set zero overwrites the automated set zero.
Automated table zeroing at the
Automated table zeroing is turned on and the RT Laser is set.
RT Laser
The positioning screen has changed and the following icons are available:
Patient model
Save at RT Laser icon
Saves the position at the external (RT) laser.
Zeros table position at the external (RT) laser.
Move to RT Laser icon
Moves the patient table back to the external (RT) laser position.
External (RT) laser
1 Tap the Save at RT Laser icon.
The current table position is zeroed at the RT Laser position. This enables the functionality to move the patient table back to zero (external (RT) laser position) after the scan.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
6 Examination
2 On the gantry operator panel, use the Table In/Out keys to move the patient table to the scan start position.
You can now perform a scan.
3 After the scan, tap the Move to RT Laser icon.
4 Press and hold the Move key until the patient table has moved back to zero position at the RT Laser.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Positioning the patient for radiotherapy without automated zeroing
Automated table zeroing is turned off.
The positioning screen has changed and the following icons are available:
Patient model
Save at RT Laser icon Saves the position at the external (RT) laser.
Move to RT Laser icon
Moves the patient table back to the external (RT) laser position.
External (RT) laser
1 Tap the Save at RT Laser icon to save the current table position at the external (RT) Laser and to activate the move request of the patient table.
The current table position at the external (RT) Laser is saved.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 302
6 Examination
2 Optional: Press and hold the Move key until movement stops.
The patient table moved to the internal (CT) Laser.
3 Optional: Zero the patient table at the internal CT Laser. Tap and hold the Horizontal zeroing icon.
4 Use the Table In/Out keys to move the patient table to the scan start position. You can now perform a scan.
5 Tap the Move to RT Laser icon.
6 Press and hold the Move key until the patient table has reached the saved position at the RT Laser.
The marks on the patient are lined up with the external laser lightmarker again.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.2.1 Performing quality measurements
CAUTION
Wrong correction tables!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ Perform the daily quality tests every day before you start the actual examinations.
You must perform calibration before you start quality measurement.
1 Call up Setup > Calibration. ( Page 162 System checkup and calibration)
2 Position the phantom. ( Page 428 Positioning the phantoms)
3 Call up Setup > Quality .
The Daily Quality Check dialog box is displayed.
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
9 Quality assurance
4 Position the patient table such that the slice thickness phantom with reference markings is in the scan plane.
5 Click OK .
The "Quality Assurance Patient" is automatically selected. Table movement starts automatically.
In the Daily Quality Check dialog box you are prompted to initiate radiation.
6 Press the Start key on the control box.
The position of the phantom set is checked and displayed. Then, the first measurement is started automatically.
For incorrect positioning of the phantom set, a message is displayed. Correct the position, if necessary.
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
9 Quality assurance
After the first measurement, a CT-image of the slice phantom is displayed in the active segment.
The next measurements are started automatically. An image is displayed with the following evaluations:
ROIs in image center and 3, 6, 9, and 12 o'clock position
Mean value of the CT value
Standard deviation

The homogeneity is calculated by evaluating a central and four different outer ROIs. For the noise measurement, the difference between the first and the second measurement is calculated and displayed.
The following evaluations are shown:
ROIs
Mean value of the CT value
Sigma value (measure for pixel noise)
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 433
9 Quality assurance
The measurements are done automatically for each defined mode.
Stopping measurement
◆ Click Cancel .
The Daily Quality Check measurement is aborted.
You have to repeat the quality measurement from the beginning before you start the actual examinations.
All measurements were performed and evaluated.
Test results are displayed in the Daily Quality Check dialog box.
7 Click OK .
The Daily Quality Check measurement is terminated.
Test results of the Daily Quality Check measurement are out of tolerance.
◆ Call your Siemens Healthineers Customer Service.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 434
